label: PF Backlog 471
title: Docs: TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md - GPL/AGPL bundle-vs-invoke/self-host + web_search plan
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08).

Extend docs/TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md with:
- Why we can't BUNDLE AGPL/GPL/LGPL (distribution obligations: GPL -> whole work GPL; AGPL -> network clause;
  LGPL -> relink nuance), and what "invoke" (run a user-installed binary, don't ship it) vs "self-host" (operator
  runs the engine; PF ships only an HTTP adapter) mean - so PF (MIT) stays redistributable.
- License != ToS (scraping can breach a provider's Terms even with a permissive client).
- Permissive web-search option: Whoogle (MIT, self-host) as the AGPL-free alternative to SearXNG; open APIs
  (Wikipedia/OpenAlex/arXiv).
- A concrete `web_search` recommendation: NOW use `http_get` for known URLs; NEXT add one neutral `web_search`
  ToolSpec with a pluggable backend (default self-host Whoogle/SearXNG via base_url, disabled unless configured;
  optional BYO-key cloud), auto-exposed via PF loop + MCP.

dashboard_impact: no UI surface.

delivery.note: docs-only; fast precheck PASS. Added GPL/AGPL/LGPL bundle-vs-invoke/self-host explanation + Whoogle(MIT) alternative + web_search now/next recommendation.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/budget_planner.py, core/control_plane.py, core/iteration_planner.py
